latest_news.headline: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill two, first fatalities in more than a week
latest_news.text: Reuters reports two people were killed in separate Israeli strikes in Gaza, the first fatalities from Israeli fire in more than a week. The strikes occurred despite the ceasefire and reconfirm canonical ceasefire_violation; israel_palestine remains at its 99% ceiling.

latest_news.headline: Iran and U.S. make competing claims over control of Hormuz
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Iran says the Strait is under its control and management while Washington says the U.S. Navy has total control. Commercial traffic remains severely constrained and no operational reopening was verified. This renews hormuz_controlled_not_closed without treating rhetoric as physical closure or zero traffic.

latest_news.headline: Türkiye, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia set pact coordination mechanisms
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Ankara says the three states will establish political and military mechanisms under their new defence pact. The pact is a major allied-position shift, but no public nuclear-sharing provision, Turkish missile test or official nuclear rhetoric crosses a configured Turkey threshold.

latest_news.headline: Israel-Lebanon talks continue while southern strikes persist
latest_news.text: Public reporting says Israel and Lebanon resumed U.S.-hosted talks, while Lebanon condemned fresh Israeli strikes in the south as unlawful. The paired evidence renews both diplomacy_active and ceasefire_violation; the raw/coupled score remains at its 95/100 ceiling.
latest_news.source: Reuters / Al Jazeera / News On AIR

latest_news.headline: Taiwan rehearses communications degradation during defence drill
latest_news.text: Associated Press reporting says Taiwan temporarily slowed mobile internet to text-only speeds during a civil-defence exercise simulating attack conditions. This is a Taiwanese resilience drill, not a new PRC military_buildup event; China remains 24 raw / 29 coupled.

latest_news.headline: North Korea fires another ballistic missile before U.S.-ROK drills
latest_news.text: Reuters confirms a ballistic missile launch from the Wonsan area toward the sea east of the Korean Peninsula. It landed outside Japan’s exclusive economic zone. This renews missile_range_test; no nuclear test, ICBM impact or strike on another state was reported.

latest_news.headline: Deadly Red Sea ship attack deepens Houthi blockade pressure
latest_news.text: Reuters reports four crew members were killed in the first deadly Houthi shipping strike of the Iran war, with two rescuers also killed; Red Sea traffic has fallen further and Saudi Red Sea oil exports have gone dark. This renews ceasefire_violation and infrastructure_strike without adding a second probability increment.

latest_news.headline: Spain rejects talks over Ceuta and Melilla sovereignty
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Madrid said the enclaves’ status is not negotiable after Morocco publicly renewed sovereignty claims. Morocco tightened border security ahead of online calls for another mass crossing. The dispute sharpens the watch but does not establish a military_buildup or new kinetic event.
latest_news.source: Reuters / Spanish Defence Ministry / Moroccan Interior Ministry

latest_news.headline: Iran says no progress on reviving interim U.S. peace framework
latest_news.text: Reuters reports a senior Iranian source said there had been absolutely no progress on reviving the June interim arrangement. Messages still move through mediators, so diplomacy_active remains a live but failing channel; no separate diplomacy_refused threshold is applied.

latest_news.headline: IEA cuts oil-supply outlook as both maritime chokepoints stay constrained
latest_news.text: The IEA projects global oil supply will fall 4.3 million barrels per day in 2026, versus 3.7 million in its July forecast, because normal Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb transit remains elusive. Live feeds show Brent at $87.24 and WTI at $81.44, both down on the day; the market check corroborates disruption but does not mechanically alter a tracker.
